claim: Analysis of single-cell profiles shows a robust, reproducible and evolutionarily conserved cell cycle program that can be resolved in a near-continuous way across human and mouse cell lines.

claim: Precocious dendritic cells express a distinctive module of genes, initiate production of interferon beta, and coordinate the subsequent response of other cells through paracrine signaling.
